name: Nebula
description: Operator workstation by BerylliumSec whose agents run commands in a local Kali container, with an interception proxy
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

techniques.comment: Suricata: 3818502 TD Nebula Kali container public address check
